params.name: account_id
params.description: It is the numeric Crazy Egg account folder in the published script URL. Crazy Egg documents the loader as `script.crazyegg.com/pages/scripts/`.
params.fix_hint: Copy the tracking script from Crazy Egg so the path carries your account and script IDs.

params.name: script_id
params.description: It is the numeric script file in the published Crazy Egg URL.
params.fix_hint: Copy the tracking script from Crazy Egg so the path ends in `{script_id}.js`.
